# Diagram Artifacts

Diagrams generated by the `software-engineer` agent via the `/create-diagram` prompt.

## Expected Artifacts

| File | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `erd-*.mmd` | ERD | Entity-relationship diagrams |
| `sequence-*.mmd` | Sequence | Sequence diagrams |
| `flowchart-*.mmd` | Flowchart | Process flowcharts |
| `class-*.mmd` | UML Class | Class diagrams |
| `state-*.mmd` | State | State machine diagrams |
| `c4-*.mmd` | C4 Model | C4 architecture diagrams |
| `mindmap-*.mmd` | Mind Map | Mind maps |
| `gantt-*.mmd` | Gantt | Visual timelines and roadmaps |

## Format

- `.mmd` — Mermaid source code (versioned, editable)
- `.png` / `.svg` — Exports for use in documentation (optional)
